newsitem.title: USA: Boise reports Q1 loss due to paper prices.
newsitem.headline: Boise reports Q1 loss due to paper prices.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company said the loss for the quarter just ended was caused by deteriorating paper prices.

For the grades produced by Boise Cascade, prices averaged $175 a ton, or 26 percent, less than prices in the first quarter of 1996 and $39 a ton, or seven percent, less than prices in the fourth quarter of 1996.

Boise Cascade's paper business had an operating loss of $22.7 million in the first quarter of 1997. This compares with an operating profit of $53.4 million in the first quarter of 1996 and an operating loss of $3.8 million in the fourth quarter of 1996.
